prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: lime green. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: lime green.
Subjects: a torn paper ribbon.
Opens on the climbing arrow, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off the bottom as the climbing arrow slackens into a torn paper ribbon that drifts down and lies flat.
Ends holding on the flat ribbon.
This composition is small-scale: a single subject sits alone on open ground.
No headline.

ON-SCREEN TEXT: none. No text appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Without that, it becomes financial engineering, not a strategic unlock.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a 2D motion design style, photographed as a flat lay under soft room light. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a solid lime green paper ground. In the upper third, a cream paper chip with the bold black sans-serif text "CROSS-SELL PROOF" is visible. In the center, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a climbing arrow is placed, characterized by rough, white torn-paper edges. A consistent light source from the upper left casts a small, soft shadow beneath each paper element. Immediately upon the first frame, the cream headline chip slides rapidly downward, exiting the bottom of the frame. Simultaneously, the climbing arrow cutout transforms; its rigid shape slackens and morphs into a long, narrow torn paper ribbon. The ribbon drifts downward with a slight, fluid motion, eventually landing flat on the lime green ground. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout. By the end of the video, the composition is small-scale, with only the single, flat paper ribbon resting alone on the open lime green expanse, holding a clear and stable reading window.

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the tactile sounds of paper. A crisp, quick paper-slap sound occurs as the headline chip slides off, followed by a soft, fluttering rustle as the ribbon drifts and a final, subtle thud as it lands flat on the ground. A faint sound of adhesive tape peeling is heard subtly in the background.
